connector.name: MotionSpec - verified web motion (reduced-motion / WCAG)
connector.registryDescription: Verifies web animation vs WCAG 2.2.2/2.3.3: validated specs, deterministic reduced-motion-safe CSS.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.motionspec.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package motionspec. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the masterplayspots account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
